Qatar Family Residence Cost Calculator

Enter your family members and residence term to see the fees at issue and the yearly cost after that.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your family residence cost

Family residence fees in Qatar

ItemAmount (QAR)When
Family residence entry visa200First time
Family member's residence permit400 a year (500 in some sources)Each issue and renewal, 1–3 years, 20% off for three
Qatar ID card100Each issue and renewal
Medical test100At issue, for adults
Health insuranceInsurer's priceCondition of residence

Example: a wife and two children, one-year residence: visas 600, permits 1,200, IDs 300 and medical 100 = QAR 2,200 plus insurance, then 1,500 a year. Renewed for three years: 3,180, or 1,060 a year.

A salary of QAR 10,000, or 6,000 with family housing from the employer, is required, with a technical or specialised job in the private sector; in government, family housing or the salary is enough. Renewing more than 90 days late risks a fine of QAR 10 a day up to 6,000. Family visits cost differently: QAR 200 per 30 days plus QAR 50 a month of insurance.

For residence violations see the Qatar overstay fine calculator.

Frequently asked questions

How much is a wife's residence permit in Qatar?

A family member's residence permit costs QAR 400 a year according to most sources (some say 500), the ID card QAR 100, the first-time residence entry visa 200 and the medical test 100. Renewing for three years gets a 20% discount.

What salary do you need to bring your family to Qatar?

QAR 10,000, or QAR 6,000 with family housing from the employer; in the private sector the job must be technical or specialised rather than labour, according to the Interior Ministry (December 2023).

Is health insurance mandatory for dependents in Qatar?

Yes. Under Law 22/2021 health insurance is a condition of residence, and no standard prices are published, so enter your insurer's premium in the calculator.
